gen-dafont-alien-encounters-manrope: Open-mouthed curves and one steady pen line make this sans read friendly and clean. Manrope holds the text in place while Alien Encounters floats above it, tall and gappy, with letters spaced like distant signals.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-work-sans: Jelly Crazies wobbles along with bowls that nearly seal shut and no calligraphic thinning, slowing every line to a leisurely walk. Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart, which opens things back up.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-bespoke-sans: Chunky, confident, level-headed: Sniglet keeps one line weight throughout. Bespoke Sans gives its curves generous room before the stem, so extended reading stays sharp and refined rather than crowded.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-archivo: Stencil cut and loud, Snowburst One bridges its tall lowercase with wide gaps between letters. And Archivo, a sans-serif with outward-opening curves, brings the commanding x-height that holds it all together.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-asap: Stencil bold and stretched tall, Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters and an opening like a sprung paper clip. Asap, a sans-serif, keeps its body height nearly level with the capitals.
gen-dafont-nulshock-work-sans: Nulshock stretches out, outlined and technical, with spacious tracking and a steady line. It's the one for attitude, while Work Sans handles the quieter job of keeping text easy to follow.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a thick, heavy-looking band of text, its letters held open and crisp. But Outrun Future runs lean and widely spaced, an outline of constant width, so the text beneath feels weightier.
gen-dafont-starborn-satoshi: Dreamy and spread thin, Starborn scatters big blank gaps between letters, then drops a dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Satoshi keeps an open e and soaring x-height, so reading rolls on.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-merriweather-sans: Large sidebearings and thin parts that are clearly thinner yet never fragile mark Metamorphous as a distinctive, commanding face. Merriweather Sans adds sturdy, tall lowercase and a clearly open e.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-archivo: Tube-like and loud, Tilt Neon never thickens or thins along any line. It owns the big shout, while Archivo, a sans with outward-opening curves, does the steady, editorial talking.
